transport_gain_definition: e^{-3t}[rho(z0)/rho(z0-t)]^3 on the zero-bump reference; linear interpolation of the sampled background

smooth_bulk_calibration.window: z > -0.85L + t + 0.05 and z < -0.05 (outside the taper causal future and away from the shell); L=3

smooth_bulk_calibration_wide_pulse.window: z > -0.85L + t + 0.05 and z < -0.05 (outside the taper causal future and away from the shell); L=3

uncompensated_single_pulse_control.description: epsilon=0 reference + one Gaussian scalar pulse at z=-0.3 (width 0.05, amplitude 0.01), warp from the discrete projection anchored at the far taper. The single pulse changes the shell data (no compensation), so the residual concentrates on the corner characteristic z=-t and grows under refinement.
